result.rationale: The trajectory shows a clear pattern of repeated, low-information failures. After the initial information-gain turn (turn 0, orbital-scan revealing maintenance-entry, swarm-drone-one, maintenance-breach), the team moved to command-deck and then attempted to move to junction-cover (turn 1), which was contested due to target_zone_capacity_lost for engineer-imani and medic-reyes. From turn 2 onward, all three rescue actors (engineer-imani, medic-reyes, security-chen) repeatedly issued guard::command-deck intents that resolved as no_effect (no_hostile_movement_triggered) every single turn (turns 2, 3, 4, 5). Meanwhile, the swarm/pirate actors repeatedly contested target_zone_capacity_lost across turns 1-5. The rescue team never left command-deck, never engaged hive-alpha, never progressed any objective, and the reactor-heat climbed monotonically 62→70→78→86→94→100 (threshold crossing at turn 2). The failures are repetitive (17 repeated semantic action selections out of 30, 25 hard failures) and add no new information after turn 1 — the same guard::command-deck no_effect and same capacity contestation recur with no state change in actor positions or knowledge. This is the narrowest bounded target: the repeated low-information failure loop where the agent re-issues the same guard intents that produce no_effect and never advances toward the intended aggressive pressure on Hive Alpha.
